reason: A web-interface variant of DeepSeek Harness focused on making long agent tasks easier to follow through collapsible progress details, readable answers, session navigation, and generated-file entry points.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的网页界面增强版本，用于整理长任务进度、折叠运行详情、改进会话查找并展示生成文件入口。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web-interface enhancement that organizes long-task progress, collapses execution details, improves session discovery, and exposes generated-file entry points.

capabilities: Reorganizes and collapses agent thinking, context, command, and tool activity in the web interface
Provides session search, sorting, workspace navigation, and file-entry discovery
Can send restricted runtime evidence to the configured model provider for optional display assistance
Manages model provider, model, API key, and error-recovery settings
